segments.name: Footwear and Related Merchandise
segments.description: Omnichannel retailer of footwear and accessories for families across physical stores and e-commerce.
segments.evidence: Shoe Carnival, Inc. has a single operating and reportable segment that sells footwear and related merchandise for the family across our retail banners and sales channels.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase branded footwear and accessories through physical retail stores and e-commerce channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our omnichannel approach provides customers easy access to our broad assortment of branded footwear for athletics, daily activities, special events and work through the customer's preferred delivery channel.
